# Copilot Instructions

These rules guide Copilot actions in this repository.

- Always create a separate branch for code changes.
- Keep changes minimal and focused.
- Always make small focused commits during development.
- Do not commit secrets.
- Update ARCHITECTURE.md on architecture decisions.
- Do not touch frontend on backend tasks, unless explicitly requested.
- Do not touch backend on frontend tasks, unless explicitly requested.
- Always check if the project is correctly building and tests are passing before opening pull requests.
- Check if README is up to date before opening pull requests.
